podcast.body: This original version of the song appeared on the 1989 indie cassette *Moon*, prior to The Smashing Pumpkins signing with Virgin Records and releasing *Gish*. It served as an early demo for the later, refined version. "The smashing pumpkins from their indie days, that's Rhinoceros, the original version from 1989, Indie cassette called Moon."

podcast.body: A "dreamily psychedelic" single from their debut album "Gish," released on the indie label Caroline Records. It managed to barely chart, reaching number 27 on the modern rock chart in late 1991. "their late 1991 single rhinoceros, released on indie label Caroline Records, ... reached number 27."
